summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing for Dr. Julio Cascante landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass on /api/ and /api/contact (POST valid, POST missing email, POST invalid email, POST missing name, GET list, persistence verified). Frontend: 22/22 UI/integration checks pass - hero heading in Spanish, hero-portrait, all 6 service cards with correct testids, all nav links, WhatsApp URLs (base wa.me/593985107013 with prefilled Spanish message parameter), floating WhatsApp FAB fixed bottom-right, contact form validation (error toast on empty), successful submission (API 200, Spanish success toast, form reset, email pipeline via Emergent Resend proxy).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: logger is defined AFTER it is used in create_contact's except block (logger.error). If the email call raises before logging.basicConfig runs, this would NameError. Move logger init above route definitions.
Backend: EmailStr requires 'email-validator' package - ensure it is in requirements.txt (it was implicitly available in the current env since tests pass).
Backend: /api/contact currently returns 200 even when email sending fails (status='stored'). Consider returning 202 or documenting this contract; current UX is fine (message still shown in Spanish).
Frontend: WhatsApp URL includes ?text=... prefilled message - not a bug, better UX, but request spec expected bare href; base matches so OK.
Frontend: Sonner toast auto-dismiss (~4s) means tests must poll quickly or listen for network response before checking toast.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ contact submissions in Mongo via API during testing (test_paciente@example.com, test_ui_toast@example.com). Not cleaned up; recipient email is a real address configured via CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL and may receive multiple notifications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py. Playwright note: page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') times out on this site (Lenis smooth scroll keeps activity going); use domcontentloaded + wait_for_selector instead. Sonner toasts auto-dismiss around 4s - either poll or use page.expect_response before clicking submit. WhatsApp links include prefilled ?text parameter; use startswith('https://wa.me/593985107013') for assertions.
